snippet.title: Bang Bang Fruit - Steam Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Bang Bang Fruit on: http://store.steampowered.com/app/587810/

Bang Bang Fruit - is a simple puzzle game in which you will feel like a pastry chef and finish cooking a beautiful cake - it put on top of cake. Credits: This game was created using Clickteam Fusion 2.5! Music by Neocoda.

Games reviews and download: http://download.online-games.co/
